102: This daily task launches the SIH client (server-initiated healing) to detect and fix system components that are vital to automatic updating of Windows and Microsoft software installed on the machine.  This task can go online, evaluate applicability of healing actions, download necessary payloads to execute the actions, and execute healing actions.
103: This boot task launches the SIH client to finish executing healing actions to fix the system components vital to automatic updating of Windows and Microsoft software installed on the machine.  It is enabled only when the daily SIH client task fails to complete execution of applicable healing actions.  This boot task never goes online and does not evaluate applicability of healing actions.
